# Lazur, Full product documentation for LLMs
# https://www.lazur.app/llms-full.txt
# Last updated: August 2026

## Overview

Lazur is an AI voice dictation and ambient writing app for macOS. Hold a global hotkey, speak, and get text pasted at your cursor in Slack, Gmail, Cursor, VS Code, Notion, Linear, and any other Mac app.

Lazur is for **live dictation while you write**, not meeting transcription or speaker labels. Speak one voice into the field you are already in. Optional **Polished** mode cleans punctuation and structure. **Transcript** mode pastes local speech-to-text only.

The product category is **ambient writing**: speak in your natural voice; Lazur handles structure, tone, and polish when you ask it to.

## Core features

### Dictation
Hold-to-talk (or toggle) system-wide. Speech is transcribed on the Mac. Choose Transcript (local text) or Polished (cloud rewrite of that text). Audio is not uploaded for speech-to-text.

### Local speech-to-text
NVIDIA Parakeet TDT runs on-device. Audio does not leave the Mac during transcription. Lazur does not identify speakers or diarize meetings.

### Cloud polish (optional)
When Polished mode is on, **text** (not audio) is sent to cloud AI to clean filler, punctuation, and layout. Paste happens once, with the polished result.

### Command Mode
Voice commands to write, rewrite, reply, or reformat using the front window and selected text. Optional screen glance (Screen Recording permission) helps “reply to this.” Pro: 50 uses/month. Power: unlimited.

### Personal dictionary and snippets
Names, jargon, and voice-triggered expansions stay local and sync if you choose.

### Zen Mode
On-device noise suppression while you dictate.

### Clipboard slots
Nine clipboard slots for quick paste.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price (USD) | Key features |
|------|-------------|--------------|
| Free | $0 | 5,000 words/month (transcript after trial) |
| Pro | $14/mo or $108/yr | Unlimited words, 50 Command Mode uses/month, 7-day free trial |

India pricing available in INR with GST at checkout.

## Platform

- Available: macOS (Apple Silicon)
- Coming soon: Windows

## Permissions required

- Microphone, for dictation
- Accessibility, to paste at the cursor
- Screen Recording (optional), so Command Mode can glance at the front window

## Privacy model

- Speech-to-text: local (NVIDIA Parakeet on-device). Audio stays on the Mac.
- History: On this Mac by default; Cloud sync is opt-in.
- Polished mode / Command Mode: text-only cloud processing when those features run.
- Full details: https://www.lazur.app/privacy

## Competitive positioning

| Competitor | Lazur advantage |
|------------|-----------------|
| Wispr Flow | Intent-aware polish and Command Mode; finished writing vs raw transcription |
| Super Whisper | System-wide polish + Command Mode beyond local STT |
| Willow Voice | Broader rewrite and Command Mode |
| Apple Dictation | AI polish, personal dictionary, Command Mode, consistent cross-app paste |
| ChatGPT / general AI | Invisible workflow; pastes where you type |
| MacWhisper | Live cursor dictation, not file or meeting transcription |

## Ideal users

1. **Engineers**, dictate in Cursor/VS Code: TODOs, PR descriptions, prompts, comments
2. **Knowledge workers**, Slack, email, docs without typing
3. **Creators / operators**, high-volume DMs and captions
4. **Students / researchers**, notes and outlines
5. **Privacy-conscious users**, local STT with optional text-only polish

## FAQ

**What is Lazur?**
A Mac dictation app: hold a hotkey, speak, paste at the cursor. Optional polish turns messy speech into send-ready writing. It is not a meeting transcriber.

**How is Lazur different from Wispr Flow?**
Wispr Flow optimizes for fast transcription. Lazur optimizes for finished, context-aware writing and Command Mode.

**Does Lazur work in Cursor and VS Code?**
Yes. One system-wide hotkey works in all Mac apps, including IDEs.

**Is voice data stored?**
Audio stays on-device (NVIDIA Parakeet). Only text may be sent for polish or Command Mode when those features run.

**Does Lazur identify speakers?**
No. It is single-speaker dictation into the app you are typing in.

**Is there a free trial?**
Yes. 7-day Pro trial, no credit card. Free tier includes 5,000 words/month after trial.
